visual.description: Primary white background used across all page sections and content areas.
Deep black background for the footer section.
Near-black used for primary headings and body text throughout the page.
Dark grey used for secondary body text and utility navigation links.
Deep purple used for links, highlighted subscribe CTA, and section label tags.
Darker navy-purple used for large display headings like the mission statement section.
Soft lavender/purple used for the announcement banner at the top of the page.
Pale blue-lavender tint used as background for the jobs/opportunity section.
Bright lime-yellow used as a text highlight background on guide card titles and the jobs marquee separator stars.
Warm golden yellow used as sparkle/star decorative accent in the mission statement section.
Soft pink-peach dominant tone of the hero background image gradient used for the newsletter signup section.
Warm golden-yellow tone present in the hero and testimonial section blurred gradient backgrounds.
Soft teal-blue tone present in the hero and testimonial gradient backgrounds.
Light grey used for subtle borders on utility elements like the currency selector.
Deep purple background used on the primary Subscribe button in the hero and footer.
Warm amber/orange color for underlined Subscribe link in the announcement banner.
